name: CFCE

cost.note: External candidate fee; IACIS membership fee is waived with purchase. Training is priced separately.

prerequisites: Four-month mentored peer-review phase, passing all four scenario problems
levelNote: Score weights the required training as well as the exam: 72 hours of required forensic training plus a four-month mentored peer review. Exam-only score 72, +7 for the training. level measures the depth a credential demands, not only how the exam checks it.
